phases.name: Content Schema and Validation
phases.objective: Keep every stored educational card valid, paired, and restart-safe.
todo: Keep migration and validation coverage current for additive fields
acceptance_criteria: Every stored card conforms to the validated schema

phases.name: Manual Proficiency Level and German Support
phases.objective: Make proficiency and language-specific guidance explicit and extensible.
todo: Add future languages only through the canonical catalog
acceptance_criteria: Language, goal, and level remain separate stored values

phases.name: Controlled Generation and Daily Card Storage
phases.objective: Generate only requested content, persist it safely, and prepare validated reuse.
done: Duplicate filtering, persistence, and partial retry
in_progress: Segment-level pooling design and validated reuse boundaries
todo: Add the pool table and gated validated write path
Add pool telemetry and inventory selection
acceptance_criteria: Restart and duplicate triggers do not regenerate persisted cards

phases.name: Interactive Card UX and Project Status
phases.objective: Expose safe card interactions and make product/engineering status explicit.
done: User-scoped same-message translation preparation with paired spoilers
Surgical legacy-card validation, repair, and atomic patch persistence
acceptance_criteria: Rendering does not change AI, quota, SRS, pool, or unrelated stored-card state; invalid legacy cards may receive one validated, repaired-field persistence update

phases.name: Custom-Word Queries and Spaced-Repetition Capture
phases.objective: Complete query capture, saved-word integrity, and review entry points.
todo: Finish custom-word UX and review-entry acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria: Repeated Add to review actions remain idempotent
Saved review entries retain complete validated cards

phases.name: Reliable Delivery, Concurrency, and Data Lifecycle
phases.objective: Make delivery, SRS, migrations, and user progress durable under retries and restarts.
todo: Add focused reliability and progress tests
Plan staged handler and formatting module boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Restart does not resend completed work
One user's failure does not stop other users

phases.name: Premium Smart Placement Test
phases.objective: Add premium placement assessment only after the core learning loop is reliable.
done: Premium boundary and product direction documented
todo: Implement after core learning-loop and measurement contracts stabilize
acceptance_criteria: Results are confirmed before being saved

phases.name: Measurement and Advanced Learning
phases.objective: Use validated usage data to add mini-quizzes, measurement, and personalization.
todo: Add feedback capture and cost/quality dashboards
acceptance_criteria: Mini-quizzes reuse existing validated learning data

decisions.title: Educational content remains AI-generated
decisions.summary: The bot validates and renders model output; it does not replace educational generation with hard-coded lessons.

decisions.title: Issue records remain canonical in issues.json
decisions.summary: The dashboard and Markdown export are views; browser edits are never canonical.

decisions.title: Compact JSON is an internal provider optimization
decisions.summary: Wire-format compactness must not change the canonical card schema or learner-facing content richness.

decisions.title: Default card detail and premium expansion
decisions.summary: The current roadmap keeps detailed as the global default; minimal cards with a premium More details action remain a product proposal until explicitly approved.
